speak.title: Role-play: a new airport for a quiet town
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: A new airport has opened near your quiet town. You like the jobs, but you worry about crowds and damage to the land. Ask the tourism manager at least two questions and say what you want.

b.text: You want more visitors because they bring money and work. Explain the benefits. Listen to the resident's worries and suggest a compromise.

phrases: I'm worried that the town won't cope.
That's a fair point, but we need the jobs.
How many visitors can the town take?
What if we set a limit?
I'd be happy if local people got a share.
We're not against tourists, we just want a say.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did you reach an agreement, and who gave up more?
